text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT detected: streaming-decode GPU OOMs on pool-prod-us-west -> pager triggered (severity: high)

maria_l: seeing continuous OOMs on 3 decode pods, memory spikes tied to long generations. spikes started ~08:12 UTC.

ajay_s: oncall here, taking lead. any immediate customer reports?

maria_l: ~2300 request drops in last 10m, 1 enterprise tenant (AcmeCorp) opened timeouts. KV-cache growth also abnormal for these sessions.

ajay_s: root cause hypothesis: clients sending very large `max_tokens` (we're seeing values >15000) causing runaway decode/stream. router currently passes straight through.

ryan_p: quick mitigation idea: clamp `max_tokens` at router layer to 4096 and reject/rewritten bigger values with a 4xx + retry_hint. That should prevent OOMs immediately.

samantha_d: +1 to clamp, will inform CS to start customer comms. I'll draft message.

maria_l: logs: ```
[2023-12-14T08:13:21Z] cudaError: out of memory at decode_kernel.cu:452
[2023-12-14T08:13:21Z] pod/decoder-7fd8 OOM, traceback: decode_loop (len=18724) -> kv_cache growth 5.8GiB -> cudaMalloc failed
```

ajay_s: go for the clamp. ryan, can you push router patch? we need it in front of prod traffic in the next 2 minutes.

ryan_p: pushing now: `/deploy router clamp-max-tokens=4096 reason="incident 1699999123"`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: router-clamp-max-tokens-1699999123 by ryan_p -> canary -> rollout

ryan_p: canary healthy. rolling to 60% in 30s.

maria_l: OOMs dropping off on decode pool. current dropped requests rate down 85%.

ajay_s: scaling spare capacity by +2 GPU nodes as a buffer. initiating node rotation for affected pods.

support-bot: Notifying customer: "We've identified elevated GPU OOMs caused by very large max_tokens. We've rolled a temporary clamp and are monitoring. We'll follow up in 30m." ticket: INC-4521

samantha_d: CS note posted. AcmeCorp acknowledged and asked for ETA on permanent fix.

ryan_p: rollout complete. routers at 100% with clamp. Observability: tail latency back to normal, memory footprint stable.

maria_l: still seeing a few stale streams that hit OOM earlier; rotating those pods now.

ajay_s: good containment. next actions: schedule postmortem, add router-side validation for max_tokens and a soft quota with metrics alert, and add a model-serving hard guard that rejects requests that would exceed estimated mem budget.

support-bot: Customer update queued: "Mitigation live, we've prevented further large-gen requests; follow-up with root cause and remediation in ongoing incident update."

maria_l: incident status -> mitigated. oncall -> ajay_s for 2h, action owners: eng-runtime (maria_l, ryan_p) for hotfix/perm change, cs (samantha_d) for comms. postmortem assigned.

ajay_s: thanks team. creating incident doc + timeline. cc: @eng-runtime @product-security

maria_l: filing telemetry dump to incident doc and attaching sample offending request headers/ids.

samantha_d: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and CS notes.

ops-bot: INCIDENT resolved -> severity downgraded to low, monitoring window 60m."
